ai.overview: The Wildcats have defended the belt twice in this reign, while the Rebels are chasing their third belt tenure in program history. These programs split their all-time series at one win apiece, but have never met with the lineal championship on the line.
key_matchups: Arizona's 96-83 win over Colorado State and 85-79 victory over UConn show they can score in bunches, but Ole Miss countered with a 92-60 rout of Central Arkansas and a 91-51 demolition of SE Louisiana
Ole Miss enters undefeated at 6-0 while Arizona owns a 6-1 record, with both teams riding five-game winning streaks into this neutral court clash
The all-time series is knotted at 1-1, with Arizona winning the most recent meeting 66-56 in 2001 and Ole Miss taking the first encounter 75-70 back in 1953
ai.betting_angles: Both teams arrive in excellent form, each winning their last five games. Arizona has faced tougher competition recently with wins over UConn and at Auburn, while Ole Miss has been dominant but against less challenging opponents. The Elo model clearly favors Arizona despite the Rebels' unblemished record.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona has already proven they can handle quality opponents this season, posting an 85-79 victory over UConn and an 80-69 road win at Auburn. Ole Miss brings an undefeated record but has yet to face the level of competition Arizona has navigated. The Wildcats' 84-66 win over Providence in their most recent outing suggests they're peaking at the right time. With the Elo model backing Arizona as a clear favorite and the Wildcats having already defended the belt twice this reign, they should have enough firepower to extend their championship run on the neutral court.
